original_card.question: Does one quantified step of the proposed #4100 all-size construction hold at its actual caller?
methods: Prove one missing implication with explicit quantified hypotheses.
Find an exact counterexample at the claimed interface boundary.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Identify the proposition and what would change downstream; do not equate a finite replay with a universal proof.

first_step.inspect: Read PROOF.md and AUDIT.md in #4100. Select one distinct obligation: CRT total repair, native/free-algebra lifting, precision/conditioning, or complete fixed-tape cost. This is an author-submitted proof, not an accepted unconditional theorem.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; no scientific replay, theorem acceptance or supplier admission. Budget any heavy replay separately.

original_card.first_experiment: Check live handoffs; name one proposition, its caller, quantified domain and dependency closure. Independently prove the implication or exhibit a precise gap/counterexample. Prioritize CRT.md total repair or COMPLEX.md free-algebra lift only if unclaimed. Stop at the chosen obligation; do not substitute finite samples or root arithmetic for an all-size proof, or launch the complete package by default.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Finite supplier improvements are useful only under the retained transfer obligations.
allowed_variations: One CRT repair, native lift, precision/conditioning or tape-cost proposition, with its exact caller.
scope_change_triggers: Replacing a quantified obligation with another finite smoke test.
Treating archive intake, an author PASS receipt or a finite composed fixture as discharge of the universal hypotheses.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4100: proposed unconditional construction and finite checks, without independent acceptance.
existing_checks.remaining: Independent proof audit of one caller-bound all-size implication; all other premises remain explicit.

actual_scope: Prove a least reusable comparison-residual barrier for all principal windows and improve the retained PR3851/PR3872 fixture bound from 4/11 to 83/234.
scope_change_reason: The original card asks for an audit of a quantified PR4100 step. This contribution instead takes PR3872 Open next question 3 and supplies a new numerical-recovery bound; predecessor audits are not its deliverable.
bottleneck_link: Scoped side result for the actual fixed-source principal-window preparation boundary. It sharpens a sufficient physical residual tolerance, but does not integrate or price production Gaussian pages or admit a supplier.
stop_rule: Stop after the first verified constant improvement; retain physical integration and further refinements as open questions.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the all-dimension argument and exact barrier. verify.py enumerates the finite fixture windows, residual vertices, same-magnitude sign class, recovery examples and rejected certificates.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Can a barrier certificate reduce the actual rounded factor-page guard at one production Gaussian window?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The new constant concerns a retained setup fixture; production integration is necessary before changing an operational precision bill.
open_questions.first_step: Freeze one actual global H, page format, incoming-grid magnitude and exact residual envelope, then compare its barrier and the complete old guard.
open_questions.blocked_by: An actual caller residual and the separately paid preparation, comparison, page emission and cleanup costs.

open_questions.question: Can the least barrier be updated cheaply after the global source itself changes?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The present reuse theorem assumes one fixed global source; repeated full comparison solves could repay any local saving.
open_questions.first_step: Specify one exact source update and determine whether its comparison-matrix change has a controlled low-rank formula.
open_questions.blocked_by: A source-update contract preserving a positive dominance witness; arbitrary sign changes do not have a fixed low-rank comparison update.

overlap.limitations: Sparse local notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are not exhaustively covered. Main-tree formula and object searches, merged PR searches and current local claims were also checked.
